'''Fera''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] of [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] descent, who served aboard the [[Alderaanian gunship]] [[Aegis (Alderaanian gunship)|''Aegis'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After learning of the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]]. the crew of the gunship, under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Caline Metara]], resorted to [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]].<ref name="Razor's Edge">''[[Razor's Edge]]''</ref>
